title: Qualify Math exact text parsing parity on .NET 10 C# 14 versus .NET 11 C# 15
commitMessage: test: qualify exact parser parity on net10 and net11

contribution.summary: Compare canonical ExactRational parsing and invalid-input refusals under independent net10 and net11 source consumers.
contribution.value: Copy nine unchanged quantities source files into offline SDK10/C#14 and SDK11/C#15 consumers; assert canonical decimal, mixed, fractional and negative-zero parsing, formatting and invalid denominator/decimal refusal, then require byte-exact result parity.
debtChanges: RS237 succeeded first-pass attempt 001 for net10/net11 quantity dimensions, incompatible arithmetic refusal and checked exponent overflow.
RS238 adds bounded parsing and refusal parity but does not qualify full package compatibility or Linux runtime execution; M8-W02-C01 stays not-ready.
contribution.nextAction: Extend migration qualification with independent package consumers and an optional Ubuntu WSL SDK11 run without requiring WSL for Windows DWF execution.
